passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.description: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

primaryAbilities.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
primaryAbilities.description:
Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within {{ buffduration }} seconds gain <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and deal an additional <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
primaryAbilities.description:
Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains <speed>{{ burrowedmovespeed }} Move Speed</speed>, {{ visionradiusmod*-100 }}% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
primaryAbilities.description:
Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ spell.reksaie:basedamagecalculation }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. At max <keywordMajor>Fury</keywordMajor>, the bite deals <trueDamage>{{ spell.reksaie:empowereddamagecalculation }} true damage</trueDamage> instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Void Rush
primaryAbilities.description: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last {{ preymarkduration }} seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ rbasedamagecalc }} plus {{ percenthealthdamage }}% max Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and resets the cooldown of <keywordMajor>Burrow / Un-burrow</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
